body: Adding citygen deps (rand_chacha =0.10.0, glam =0.32.1) and resolving with cargo --offline fails: offline re-resolution prefers cached nix 0.31.2 while gilrs-core needs ^0.31.3 (lock has 0.31.3, source never downloaded). Resolved online in a scratch copy instead; the implementer must take the pre-resolved lock.

citygen v1 keeps GDD node jitter and works on convex polygons (clip/inset/OBB/SAT) instead of an axis-aligned rectangle grid; superblock merges and alleys limited to one per block (dual matching) so road and lane connectivity hold by construction.

GameState {Loading, Playing} lives in new gta_sim flow/; WorldSource::{TestArea, City{seed}} passed to compose_sim so the T1 headless gates keep the test arena while the game and new city gates use citygen. Alternative rejected: migrate T1 terrain gates to the city (no stairs/box fixtures there).

Golden hashes live in one file crates/citygen/tests/golden_hashes.txt read by the citygen golden test, the gta_sim runtime test and tools/qa/scenarios/t2.py. Alternative rejected: constants duplicated in Rust and Python.

Loading-screen text stays a code literal in ASCII: bevy_text 0.19.1 default FiraMono-subset has 95 glyphs, no Cyrillic; assets/ui/strings.ron is introduced by T5 per GDD section 7. Alternative: create strings.ron now for one string.

Lane graph v1 conflict model: every turn connector carries its intersection road-node id; one conflict zone per intersection (T15 reserves it). Alternative: explicit connector-crossing points, deferred to T15.

Loading overlay: keep DespawnOnExit(Loading) and build city surface meshes in client OnEnter(Playing) instead of V2's extra client 'geometry ready' flag. Alternative rejected: readiness flag machinery. Reason: bevy_state-0.19.1 app.rs:244-265 despawns DespawnOnExit entities inside StateTransition (ExitSchedules) of the same frame whose EnterSchedules run OnEnter(Playing); building meshes are attached by On<Add,CityBuilding> one frame earlier; render extraction follows the whole Main schedule, so no ECS frame shows the world without geometry. Residual pipeline-compile pop is owner-visible.

Grid lines: replace PLAN remainder rule (r>max -> two r/2) by split_interval(L,lo,hi): n=ceil(L/hi), reject if n*lo>L, equal base plus zero-mean offsets within +-min(base-lo,hi-base). Alternative rejected: patching the remainder with neighbour redistribution. Probe scratch/pr2/split_probe.py: old rule gives a sub-min block in 10008/20000 runs for L=250 [70,90]; new rule 0 violations in 60000.

POI guarantee: generate() returns Result<CityLayout, GenError>; districts are kinded after blocks are final and re-kinded to Residential until two Residential/Industrial districts own blocks; the lowest-id non-degenerate block of each district may not become a park; gangs are assigned before hospital/police. Alternative rejected: PLAN fallback to any non-Downtown district (violates the gang-territory invariant) and infallible signature with panic inside an async task.

citygen contains_convex takes eps in metres (edge direction normalised) instead of cross-product units; the plan's 1e-3 tolerances are metre tolerances and the cross-product form failed lots_do_not_overlap on exact boundary vertices at |x|~500 m. Alternative rejected: loosening the gate eps.

Flip-RED for lots_do_not_overlap sabotages the second child's cut line (shifted 1 m into the first child) instead of the plan's 'second child gets the original polygon'. Alternative rejected: the plan's sabotage makes every accepted split recurse on the whole block to depth 16 (up to 2^16 leaves per block), a hang rather than a RED.

Draft clip_half_plane from the interrupted attempt dropped frontage flags of kept sides (all flags became false); rewritten to carry flags[i] on kept and entering sub-sides and false on the cut side, with a zero-length-side dedup. Alternative rejected: patching the draft's incoming/outgoing bookkeeping.

Review issue 1 (sidewalk mesh fills whole curb polygon) skipped: plan-specified presentation, GDD 2.2 does not define lot-interior surfaces, owner-visible on first frame, T3 reworks sidewalks with curbs. Alternative rejected: curb-to-inner ring mesh plus a new lot-ground colour in render.ron.

different_seeds_differ now compares layout_hash of a clone with seed=0 (geometry only); flip-RED by zeroing the seed in rng::stream. Alternative rejected: comparing roads.nodes only (misses lots/buildings).

one_static_collider_per_building matches each layout building to a collider by centre and checks is_static, cuboid half extents and rotation*X == axis. Flip-RED with Kinematic (not Dynamic: a Dynamic body moves and trips the centre match before the is_static assert). Alternative rejected: With<RigidBody> count only.

QA flip-RED by swapping PlayerSpawn axes (spawn.y, 0, spawn.x) stayed GREEN: the centre spawn (7.2, -40.2) swapped lands on the sidewalk of the E-W street through the origin, so it is not a sabotage of the sidewalk property. Used spawn.x*0.5 (onto the carriageway) instead, which went RED.
